description: A flat board, slightly larger than the volume, placed above and below a stack of sections so the press can bear evenly across them. Pairs of these boards sandwich the pile that goes into the standing press.
name: pressing board

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter V, p.80. Internet Archive.
